description: Flights that ended in the last 60 minutes, newest first: callsign, why it ended, how many calls it heard and how many of those were stepped on. Counts only. Real flights only.

configuration.query: FROM unstep-flights | WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - 60 minutes | KEEP @timestamp, callsign, reason, calls_heard, blocked_calls, readbacks, clearances | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
